notes.title: The urban supernatural Galgame “BROKEN God Awakening” is now on sale! Fir
notes.content:
The urban supernatural Galgame “BROKEN God Awakening” is now on sale! First week -20% off in the link please poke: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2011240/BROKEN_God_Awakening/ 


About this game 
Mysterious psychic powers, twisted machinery, and treacherous deities, this is a transcendent world unknown to ordinary people.
“In order to prevent this city from turning into ruins, I'm going to borrow your room for the night.”
Looking at this young girl in black who forced her way into my home, at this point I hadn't realized that my daily life was about to be gone.
----------------------------- 
Here we have 
dozens of characters with beautifully drawn standups!
The single character line has more than 200,000 words and about 8-10 hours of game content!
A large number of beautiful CG! 
The main characters all Chinese voice!
